response:
The new decoder interprets entry offsets as signed 16-bit word offsets and reads all glyph replacements from `max(0, ceil(substOffset / 2) - offset)` up to `min(numGlyphs, floor(size / 2) - offset)`. These bounds include every glyph whose complete replacement word lies within the substitution table and the subtable, for both negative and positive offsets; the new subtable reader also prevents reading into subsequent subtables.

YES
